schools.heroTitle: Bring Certified Arabic & Quran Education to Your Whole Institution
schools.heroSubtitle: A dedicated institutional platform with bulk student onboarding, a live administrator dashboard, and certified teachers — built for Islamic schools, community centers and homeschool cooperatives educating groups of children together.
schools.heroStat1Sub: Add an entire class in minutes, not one parent signup at a time
schools.heroStat2Sub: Track seat usage, classes and enrolled students in real time
schools.heroStat3Sub: The same 150+ certified teachers used across our platform
schools.featuresTitle: Everything an Institution Needs to Run Arabic & Quran Classes
schools.featuresSubtitle: The same platform families use, with the tools an administrator needs to manage many students at once
schools.featureRosterDesc: Upload your class list once and every student gets a real account, linked to your institution, ready to join classes — no manual one-by-one signups.
schools.featureDashboardDesc: See licensed seats, seats in use, class counts and enrolled students at a glance, and manage every classroom from one place.
schools.featureClassroomDesc: A live shared whiteboard, attendance, hand-raise and reactions, and a real class roster — the same live classroom technology used across the platform.
schools.featureCurriculumDesc: 7 tailored learning tracks spanning Arabic foundations, reading, writing, conversation, listening, Quran reading & Tajweed, and Islamic studies.
schools.featureTeachersDesc: Every class is led by one of our certified teachers — the same educators who teach on the individual-family side of the platform.
schools.featureReportingDesc: Real attendance records and grading tools give your administration visibility into how every class and every student is progressing.
schools.audienceSubtitle: If you're educating a group of children together, this is built for you
schools.audienceSchoolDesc: Full-time and weekend Islamic schools adding structured Arabic & Quran classes to their curriculum.
schools.audienceCenterDesc: Community and mosque-run weekend or evening Arabic programs serving families in your community.
schools.audienceCoopDesc: Homeschool groups pooling children together for live, certified Arabic & Quran instruction.
schools.pricingTitle: Per-Seat Licensing, Sized to Your Institution
schools.pricingSubtitle: Pricing is based on the number of enrolled students (seats), with volume discounts at larger sizes — tell us your numbers and we'll send a straightforward quote, no obligation.
